description:
FlareForge is a passionate team of young innovators from Ghana competing in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our project, FireScope AI, aims to transform NASA's MODIS and VIIRS satellite data into meaningful insights about wildfire activity. Through data science, AI, and interactive visualizations, we seek to identify fire patterns, support environmental monitoring, and help protect communities across Africa and beyond.

FlareForge: Born in Ghana. Built for Earth. Powered by Space.
